title: Zero v2 Remote Command Envelope
description: Command sent from Platform to Zero. T-P.4 contract. No shell exec command type.

command_type.description: Allowed types: backup.restore, config.set, config.get, agent.cancel, capability.refresh. NOT allowed: shell.exec, system.eval.

signature.description: HMAC-SHA256 signature of (id + command_type + params + received_at)
